entities.name: Jegantha
entities.description: A legendary elemental elk of Ikoria, mana incarnate, that amplifies any magic cast nearby.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who cast an enlarging spell near Jegantha and wonders about a bonder for it.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Jegantha defended Ikoria.

events.summary: Vivien Reid tries a simple enlarging spell on a beetle near Jegantha, and the beetle becomes colossal.
events.quote: tried a simple enlarging spell on a beetle, which assumed truly colossal dimensions

events.summary: Jegantha fights in defense of Ikoria during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Jegantha fought in defense of Ikoria during the New Phyrexian Invasion
